title: OpenTelemetry 规模化迁移：指标平台走向统一可观测性
english: A CNCF Blog post describes a large-scale migration of a metrics platform toward OpenTelemetry. The existing metrics pipeline had relied for most of the last decade on gostatsd, an open-source StatsD implementation maintained by the team. Gostatsd primarily operated as a sidecar on every host. The migration highlights a practical observability challenge: evolving a long-running, widely deployed metrics pipeline while preserving the operational role it already serves. For senior operations engineers, the key topic is not merely adopting a new telemetry standard, but planning how instrumentation, host-level deployment patterns, and metric pipelines change together at scale.
chinese: CNCF Blog 分享了一项将指标平台迁移至 OpenTelemetry 的规模化实践。该团队此前长期依赖其维护的 gostatsd——一个开源 StatsD 实现，并将其作为每台主机上的 sidecar 运行。已提供的信息表明，这不是单纯替换组件，而是对长期运行、广泛部署的指标管道进行演进。关注点应包括：现有埋点和指标管道如何衔接、主机级 sidecar 部署模式如何变化，以及如何在大规模迁移中保持可观测性能力的连续性。
why_it_matters: 这与云原生可观测性直接相关：OpenTelemetry 正在成为统一遥测采集与传输的重要方向。对 AIOps 而言，指标数据的标准化和管道演进是后续分析、告警与自动化决策的基础。对资深运维开发岗位而言，能够设计并推进跨主机、跨组件的可观测性迁移，比仅会部署单一工具更能体现平台工程能力。
interview_expression: I am interested in observability migrations that treat telemetry as a platform capability, not just a tooling change. At scale, I would evaluate how the metrics pipeline, deployment model, and operational continuity evolve together.
